settings.subtitle: OUR MANIFESTO // GEN 04
settings.title: LumaLoop exists to bridge the gap between everyday technology and the future.
settings.story_text:
We started with a singular obsession: standard consumer phone mounts fail under vibration, cables clutter workspaces, and fragile flagship devices are left vulnerable to drops. Flagship hardware deserves companion engineering that matches its ambition.

By combining pneumatic vacuum physics, high-flux neodymium magnetic arrays, and impact-resistant hinge metallurgy, LumaLoop redefines the physical objects you interact with every single day.

settings.review_text: The foldable 360° vacuum suction mount on my car windshield is rock solid. Holds my iPhone 16 Pro Max over steep potholes without a millimetre of slip.
The 3-in-1 MagSafe station completely cleaned up my desk workspace. Simultaneous charging with zero coil whine and cold anodized touch.
Finally, a protective case that doesn't ruin the hinge geometry of the Galaxy Z Fold. The TriFold Shield fits with zero wobble and looks futuristic.
